newsitem.title: UK: Benson to buy Combat, sell Realm Products.
newsitem.headline: Benson to buy Combat, sell Realm Products.

text.p: Britain's Benson Group Plc said on Tuesday that it had conditionally agreed to buy Combat Engineering Ltd for a total consideration of 4.25 million stg.
The company also said it was selling its Realm Products Ltd to its management for a maximum one million stg.
Benson would be paying 2.75 million stg in cash and alloting 5.72 million new shares to Combat as coinsideration.
The new shares will be offered on ratio of a one-for-five shares held. The offer has been underwritten by Albert E. Sharp.
